message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Fresh sweep completed for the 24-hour daily run ending 2026-06-08 05:10 IST, using the monitored product list in Products.txt. One credible, product-matched issue was confirmed for the monitored list: SolarWinds Serv-U CVE-2026-28318, which CISA-linked reporting says is being exploited. One WordPress ecosystem item is included separately as a possible match because it affects a plugin that was not named in the product list.

**Finding 1: SolarWinds Serv-U unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability reported as exploited**

- Product: SolarWinds Serv-U
- Issue: CVE-2026-28318
- Severity: High / CVSS 7.5, as stated by SolarWinds
- Description: SolarWinds says Serv-U can be crashed by specially crafted unauthenticated POST requests using `Content-Encoding: deflate`, causing denial of service. The Hacker News reported on June 6, 2026 that CISA added the issue to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog based on evidence of active exploitation.
- Why it appears relevant: The monitored list includes SolarWinds. Serv-U is a SolarWinds managed file transfer / FTP server product, so this maps to the monitored SolarWinds product family even though Serv-U is not listed separately.
- Sources: SolarWinds advisory: https://www.solarwinds.com/trust-center/security-advisories/cve-2026-28318; The Hacker News: https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/cisa-adds-actively-exploited-solarwinds.html

**Possible matches needing review**

**Everest Forms Pro WordPress plugin remote code execution under active exploitation**

- Product: WordPress ecosystem plugin, Everest Forms Pro
- Issue: CVE-2026-3300
- Severity: Critical / CVSS 9.8, as stated by Wordfence
- Description: Wordfence and BleepingComputer report active exploitation of an unauthenticated PHP code injection flaw in Everest Forms Pro versions 1.9.12 and earlier, allowing arbitrary code execution on affected WordPress sites that use the vulnerable plugin and feature.
- Why review is needed: The monitored list includes WordPress, but it does not specifically list Everest Forms Pro. Treat this as relevant only if that plugin is deployed.
- Sources: Wordfence vulnerability record: https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/wordpress-plugins/everest-forms-pro/everest-forms-pro-1912-unauthenticated-remote-code-execution-via-calculation-field; BleepingComputer: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/critical-everest-forms-pro-flaw-exploited-to-take-over-wordpress-sites/

**Reviewed but excluded**

- Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager CVE-2026-20245: fresh and credible, but the monitored Cisco scope is Cisco Nexus, Cisco UCS, and Cisco Fabric Extender; the advisory did not map to those products.
- Recently published NVD records for GL.iNet, MetaGPT, and Tiobon products: fresh, but they did not match the monitored product list.
- MongoDB-family terms, including MongoDB server, mongod, mongos, Atlas, Ops Manager, drivers, connectors, and official components: no credible in-window matching vulnerabilities were confirmed.

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended if SolarWinds Serv-U is deployed, especially if internet-exposed. Also check whether Everest Forms Pro is present on any WordPress sites before prioritizing that possible match. No other fresh, credible, product-matched vulnerabilities were confirmed for the monitored list in this daily window.
